about.intro: I am a dermatologist and rheumatology–dermatology fellow at Mass General Brigham, with clinical interests in inflammatory and complex medical dermatology, dermatopathology, and clinical AI evaluation.
highlights: Rheumatology-dermatology fellow at Mass General Brigham, working in Dr. Adam Rodman's research lab; completed dermatology residency at Johns Hopkins in 2026.
Princeton AB in Molecular Biology (Summa Cum Laude, Phi Beta Kappa); MD from Penn (Alpha Omega Alpha).
AAD Council on Science and Research (2025-2027); Johns Hopkins House Staff Council.
